application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Variation of Condition 3 (plans submitted) and Condition 15 (BREEAM) to allow enlarging the footprint of the proposed Studio 5 by 1.87m to achieve a revised structural grid; extending the Studio 5 lift and stair core up to the roof level and approved terrace, the roof terrace has been widened to accommodate WCs as part of the core extension; enlarging the occupier facilities in the amenity pavilion to provide more cycle storage and a larger shower space as well as a studio wellness space for the Power Road Studios campus, the amendments include the removal of the waste store currently proposed to be located within the amenity pavilion; and associated changes to the hard and soft landscaping to accommodate the slightly increased depth of Studio 5, the rationalisation of the car parking layout, as well more trees and permeable paving following planning permission 00890/114/P1 dated 14/08/2017 for erection of a five storey office block with associated cycle storage, parking, landscaping and other works as a replacement for studio 5 and erection of an additional floor to studio 1 to create additional office space
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. Condition : 2 - 2.	The materials to be used in the construction of external surfaces of the development shall be those approved by planning permission 00890/114/P1(2) on 29th November 2017.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Notwithstanding the provision of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), the new floor space of Studio 1 and Studio 5 hereby approved shall be used for office, Research & Development and/or light industrial uses only and for no other purpose (including any change of use to residential via the prior approval process).

Condition : 4 - 4.	The planting and tree details shall be in line with those approved by planning permission 00890/114/P1(5-12) on 23rd January 2018. All tree planting shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details.

Condition : 5 - 5.	If within a period of ten years from the date of the planting of any tree pursuant to the requirements of condition 5, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 6 - 6.	The Waste Management Strategy details shall be in line with the hereby approved Waste Management Plan. The Waste Management Strategy shall thereafter operate in accordance with those details.

Condition : 7 - 1.	The cycle parking facility details shall be in line with those approved by planning permission 00890/114/P1(5-12) on 23rd January 2018 and the hereby approved Transport Statement Addendum. The approved cycle parking facilities shall be implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of Studio 5 or the roof extension to Studio 1 hereby approved. Thereafter, the approved cycle spaces shall be retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 8 - 8.	 (A). The drainage designs and associated detailed maintenance plans for each of the drainage feature components shall be in line with those approved by planning permission 00890/114/P1(5-12) on 23rd January 2018. The drainage and associated maintenance details shall thereafter operate in accordance with the approved plans.
(B). Prior to the first occupation/use of Studio 5, the roof extension to Studio 1 or the amenity pavilion hereby permitted, evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 10 - 10.	The Delivery and Service Plan details shall be in line with the hereby approved Delivery and Service Plan. The Delivery and Service Plan shall thereafter operate in accordance with these details.

Condition : 11 - 11.	The contamination strategy on the site shall be carried out in accordance with details approved by planning application 00890/114/P1(5-12) on 23/01/2018. The Contamination strategy shall thereafter operate in accordance with these details and scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.

During the course of the development: 
i. The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues. 

Before the development is first brought into use: 

ii. The agreed scheme for decontamination approved by planning application 00890/114/P1(5-12) on 23/01/2018, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 12 - 12.	Prior to the commencement of above ground works for Studio 5, the roof extension to Studio 1 or the amenity pavilion hereby permitted, a Car Park Management Plan, to include confirmation and location of the provision for disabled spaces and electric vehicle charging points, and a review mechanism for the allocation of spaces for visitors, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be put into effect when the development is first occupied.

Condition : 13 - 13.	Prior to the first occupation of each of Studio 5 and the roof extension to Studio 1 hereby permitted, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to show that each respective phase of development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 14 - 14.	(A). Within three months of commencement of above ground works for Studio 5 or the roof extension to Studio 1 hereby permitted, a BREEAM Design Stage certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating will be achieved for each respective phase of development. 
(B). Within three months of the first occupation of each of Studio 5 and the roof extension to Studio 1 hereby permitted, a BREEAM Post-Construction Review certificate and summary score sheet (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to show that an 'Excellent' (minimum score 70%) rating has been achieved for each respective phase of development.

Condition : 15 - 15.	Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, no furniture, equipment, planting or screening shall be placed on the roof terraces to Studio 1 hereby permitted.
